Package arztis.econnector.common

Class DialogCreator

java.lang.Object
arztis.econnector.common.DialogCreator
public class DialogCreator extends Object
This class includes methods to login and log-off for GINA. Moreover some information about contract partner and real person are stored.

      public Object createDialog(RegisterParam param, String cardToken)
      creates GINA dialog.
      Parameters:
      param - register parameter, which includes all necessary information to register a user such as name and role.
      cardToken - card token of used Admin-Card

    • registerGdaMa

      public Object registerGdaMa(AuthServiceStub.GdaMa gdaM, String role, String ordId)
      This method registers employee of healthcare provider. This is needed for ELGA because the hits of documents are logged.
      Parameters:
      gdaM - AuthServiceStub.GdaMa with details about real person, which wants to authenticate
      role - role, which can be
    • 700 Ärztin/Arzt
    • 701 Zahnärztin/Zahnarzt
    • 702 Krankenanstalt
    • 703 Einrichtung der Pflege
    • 704 Apotheke
      • All current values can be viewed here: (https://termpub.gesundheit.gv.at/TermBrowser/gui/main/main.zul?loadType=CodeSystem&loadName=ELGA_GDA_Aggregatrollen)
      ordId - ID of surgery of the healthcare provider, where employee works
      Returns:
      if authentication was successful Boolean is returned, otherwise Message with error details is returned.
